sequence_notes.rule: Lock Veo's camera on every frame with a grid (streets, stadium, fields, ships' hulls, bridges, the city map); Premiere does the pushes and pulls.
sequence_notes.why: Camera moves are what make Veo redraw a scene. Where there's no grid (the valley, the cloud tops, the rise to the Earth's curve, the Moon) Veo may fly the camera, per GPOM's look.md.

sequence_notes.rule: The whole sequence is one long zoom out: every Premiere move from frame 7 onward is a PULL BACK (scale down), so the cuts feel like one continuous climb.
sequence_notes.why: Kai: 'we could be zooming out… a much wider zoom out to finish on.'

sequence_notes.rule: Cuts quicken through the country (about two bars, 2.8s, each) and slow right down in orbit (four bars, 5.5s, each).
sequence_notes.why: The country frames share 193–211 with the sky; orbit has 19.5s for five frames, room to breathe at the end.

sequence_notes.rule: Flashes at 3 a second or fewer: lightning, beams and lights going out are spaced a second apart.
